info.title: DancePro V2 HTTP API
info.description: Source-reviewed contract for every operation in routes/api.php. Examples are fictional/redacted, not runnable credentials or upload signatures. Environment-configurable limits are described as defaults. See docs/api/README.md for scope, workflow and verification limits.

post.description: Only unfinished processing assets. Files must use allowlisted relative paths and exact MIME types. Upload SHA256-signed raw bytes directly to returned URLs using every returned header and no Laravel bearer token. Return header names may vary. Default TTL 15 minutes. Reissue identical pending batch/key for fresh URLs. HLS master signing requires completed child-playlist and segment batches. Requires an active staff/admin account and explicit token ability concert-media:upload.

sanctumBearer.description: Opaque Laravel Sanctum token from POST /api/auth/login. Not JWT; keep in Keychain. Do not send to S3/CloudFront.

token.description: Opaque Sanctum bearer token, not a JWT. Shown only on login; example is redacted.

concert_uuid.description: Conditionally emitted when the concert relation is loaded. Omitted in collection list responses.

asset_count.description: Conditionally emitted when the asset count is loaded. Omitted in collection update responses.

collection_uuid.description: Conditionally emitted when the collection relation is loaded; loaded by current asset API responses.

size_bytes.description: Current default maximum 104857600 bytes; controlled by media.max_single_upload_bytes.

checksum_sha256.description: Base64 of a raw 32-byte SHA256 digest, not a hex string.

files.description: Distinct relative paths. Current default max 100 files, 10 GiB total; configurable.

checksum.description: Base64 of a raw 8-byte CRC64NVME checksum. Not CRC64-ECMA or MD5.

checksum_crc64nvme.description: Base64 of a raw 8-byte CRC64NVME checksum. Not CRC64-ECMA or MD5.

parts.description: Distinct part numbers; current default max 100 entries per request, configurable.

checksum_crc64nvme.description: Base64 of a raw 8-byte CRC64NVME checksum. Not CRC64-ECMA or MD5.

parts.description: Distinct, contiguous numbers starting at 1. Include all parts with the exact returned ETags.

checksum_crc64nvme.description: Base64 of a raw 8-byte CRC64NVME checksum. Not CRC64-ECMA or MD5.

download.authentication: Unlocked concert session, valid temporary signed access URL, or password-free concert; no bearer ability.

errors.404: Concert or published visible available asset not found

download.delivery: Concert CloudFront for s3_concerts when configured; otherwise short-lived signed S3. Legacy storage always signs its own disk. Attachment disposition is included before signing.
